title: Lifting a map from a summand of a finite free module along a surjection, locally
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma lifts a map from a direct summand of a finite free module along a surjection of O_U-modules, locally on a covering (statement lines 11771-11785). The proof reduces to the free case (proof lines 11788) and then observes that a map out of a finite free module is a tuple of sections, so the lifting problem becomes the local liftability of sections along a surjection, which is the characterisation of surjective maps of sheaves (proof lines 11789-11792). The non-formal content is the identification of the dotted arrow with lifted sections, which is where finite freeness is used. The claim is H2: a short reduction and one local-liftability statement, with the Xy-pic diagram delivered as written.
